title: Mixing: Must Do Something About It, San Ferry Anne, Warm And Beautiful by Wings | 1976
content:
Studio Two, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Peter Henderson

The last of four final mixing sessions for Wings’ fifth album Wings At The Speed Of Sound took place on 29 February 1976.

The songs were mostly mixed in their order on the album. On this day the closing ballads were mixed in stereo: ‘Must Do Something About It’, ‘San Ferry Anne’, and ‘Warm And Beautiful’.

This was the final studio session for the album.
